text:
marco: Quick sync: proposal to split transform-service into two pieces: transform-core (stateless, model-facing transforms) and transform-orch (tenant routing, billing hooks, side-effects). Goal: reduce blast radius and make hotpath code minimal.
tegan: I like separating hotpath. Biggest open question: who owns the KV caching layer? We can't have double-writes and cache stampede during cutover.
divya: Suggestion: single owner during migration (orch holds ownership), core exposes a cache-read hint API that orch calls. After migration, consider migrating ownership to core for simpler locality.
sam: Operational constraints: rollout must allow graded traffic splits per-tenant and per-route. Also need to keep transforms feature-flagged for 90 days before pruning.
marco: Proposed safety rules:
- Canary with read-mirror for 48h -> compare outputs (diff-rate < 0.1%)
- Latency SLO: p95 delta <= 20ms for paid tiers, <= 40ms for free tier
- Error budget guard: abort cutover if errors > 0.5% sustained for 10m
tegan: For correctness we need deterministic transform tests + a prompt-set driven eval that lives in evals repo. Also add a "semantic-diff" that tolerates ordering-only differences.
divya: Also call out side-effects: webhook delivery, billing events must remain exactly once. Orch will own idempotency keys during migration.
ci-bot: CI: integration job transform-migration-smoke queued. Tests: unit, integration(10m), semantic-diff-checker.
sam: Practical rollout plan:
1) implement core + shim in orch that forwards to core
2) run read-mirror (100% mirror) for 48h on low-risk tenants
3) enable 1% traffic to core for selected tenants, ramp to 25% over 2d
4) validate metrics + runbook checks, then flip 100%
5) keep shim for 30d safe-slab, then prune if no fallbacks used
commands:
```bash
# enable mirror for tenant-17
./ffctl set transform-migration tenant-17 mirror=true
```
marco: Timeline: implementation sprint (2 weeks), infra canary (1 week), staged rollouts (2-4 weeks). Total ~6-8 weeks.
tegan: Dev ergonomics: need local docker-compose profile to run core+orch with lightweight cache to validate end-to-end. Also update SDK clients to surface new error codes.
divya: Data migration note: we need to export small cache snapshots for tenants with hot-warm affinity. Ops should prep migration tooling.
sam: Alerting: per-tenant semantic-diff rate, p95 latency delta, 5xx, webhook-dedup errors. Add dashboard card in console for rollout owners.
marco: Action items:
- Divya: cache ownership doc + migration stub (ETA 4d)
- Tegan: eval prompt-set + semantic-diff checker (ETA 5d)
- Sam: rollout automation + dashboards (ETA 6d)
- Marco: PR for service split API + shim (ETA 7d)
We'll reconvene in 48h to review PRs.
tegan: noted. :thumbsup:
